 Culture Beat Little Giants Festival in Hyderabad on November 15: Science, Art and Fun
 Subhransu Satpathy 11 Nov 2026 12:34 PM Share this: Little Giants Festival will feature science, art and creative activities for children at T-Works, Hyderabad, on November 15. HYDERABAD: Children in Hyderabad can explore science, art, fitness and entrepreneurship at the Little Giants Festival, a one-day event featuring interactive exhibits, creative workshops, performances and a young entrepreneur pitch opportunity.
 The festival will feature 20 hands-on science exhibits, art workshops for different age groups, fitness activities, storytelling sessions and a dedicated play area. The standard entry pass costs ₹599, including GST, and admits one child and one adult. 
 Festival combines science experiments with creative learning
 The festival revolves around three themes — science, art and movement. Through these activities, children can explore, experiment, create, play and express themselves.
 From Charminar to Golconda Fort: Explore Hyderabad with Telangana Tourism
 At the Science Discovery Lab, children can explore 20 interactive exhibits and test scientific principles through activities based on everyday phenomena.
 Meanwhile, IndFame will conduct integrated art workshops that combine creative activities with academic subjects. All-day SciArt workshops will also bring science and art together through hands-on experiences. 
 In addition, children can enjoy games and recreational activities in the dedicated play area.
 Stage performances, storytelling and young talent
 The stage programme will feature Education through Art by Geetha Bhascker and the Little Giants Talent Showcase.
 Children can also pitch their entrepreneurial ideas through the Little Giants Pitch initiative, which offers a platform to present their creativity and business concepts.
 Adding to the programme, Bhoomika Theatre Group will conduct storytelling sessions for young visitors.
 Little Giants Festival date, venue and ticket prices
 The Little Giants Festival will take place on November 15, 2026, from 10 am to 8 pm at T-Works, Silpa Gram Craft Village, Madhapur, Hyderabad.
 The standard entry pass currently costs ₹599, including GST, against the regular price of ₹699. It covers entry for one child and one adult.
 However, visitors should note that specialised science workshops and the Little Giants Fitness Challenge require separate paid passes. These activities do not come under the standard entry ticket.
 For registrations and enquiries, visit the official Little Giants Festival website or call +91 81430 44464. Visitors can also email contact@littlegiantsfestival.com .
 Event details, ticket prices and activities are based on information shared by the organisers and may change.
